scope: Six fail-closed checks bind the three existing Three-Domain source ports to a local directed Tube Occupancy view and its derived +1 joint witness. The frozen TESA/Lissajous capture-replay cut is not modified.

source_ports.native_output: thresholded binary grid and C00/C01/C10/C11 ledger
thresholded spin grid and C00/C01/C10/C11 ledger

C00.meaning: inactive retention; observed zero-state, not NULL

tube_occupancy_view.meaning: Directed internal occupancy addresses for the between-space of each source channel.
tube_occupancy_view.boundary: The bins are view addresses. They do not identify cube axes, add a fourth source, or establish a physical tube mechanism.

derived_joint.label: +1 / Zbar
derived_joint.meaning: Arithmetic centroid of the three existing ledger phasors; derived witness only.

residual_grammar.exact: SOURCE -> VIEW -> LOST INFORMATION -> RESIDUAL / SECOND VIEW -> RETURN

checks_1_to_6.expect: Exactly chemistry, life and physics; ordinals 1, 2 and 3 are distinct.
Each source channel exposes all eight unique directed local occupancy addresses.
Zbar is derived from exactly the three readouts and is not a fourth source port.
No path exists from Zbar into chemistry, life or physics source state.
Missing source, incomplete occupancy, altered fingerprint or residual mismatch returns HOLD.
Replay restores source ordinal/address, complete occupancy fingerprint and joint witness exactly.

claim_boundary: This is a deterministic source-bound interface and contract check. Port colors and Tube Occupancy bins are typed display semantics; they do not prove a shared mechanism, physical channel topology, cube-axis identity, resonance law or new mathematical object.
